svg.aria-label: Adelante. Live on the App Store. A daily quote on your Home Screen, Lock Screen and Apple Watch, for the days you don’t feel like opening an app. Built with Flutter, Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin. The screenshot shows the widget gallery, Today and Discover screens.
